text: The Patriots' turnover differential troubles deepened Thursday night as they fell to Caleb Williams and the Bears 30-24 in Chicago, a loss that Mike Vrabel identified as particularly frustrating given that ball security stands as one of his four pillars of team identity. Drake Maye's performance drew detailed film review attention from the beat, though the quarterback faced the added challenge of operating without starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown, both ruled out due to injury before the contest. On a brighter note, running back Rhamondre Stevenson posted a career-high in receiving yards and continues his remarkable consistency, now on the cusp of 100 carries for the sixth consecutive season, doing the little things right even as the team searches for answers on the turnover front.
